meta.doc:
Arena legends: 5-8 retired club legends per club in clubs.json -> data/arena-legends.json.
Run: python3 -I tools/arena_legends.py [--resume]   (free: Wikidata SPARQL + English Wikipedia API, no keys; ~150 polite requests)

Candidates (Wikidata): footballers with an English Wikipedia article and a "member of sports team" (P54) statement for
the club; apps/goals = the P1350/P1351 qualifiers summed over spells (mostly league games); era = first start .. last end.
Retired = the English Wikipedia infobox has no current_club, its last senior years entry is closed (e.g. "2004–2009"),
and the article lead does not say "who plays" without "former" (free agents have a closed infobox too).
Fame for this club: rank = club_apps * ln(1 + Wikipedia language editions); a spell with unknown apps counts 25 apps per year.
Only players with >= 50 known apps (or >= 4 years when apps are unknown) qualify; a club with < 5 then retries
with >= 15 apps / 2 years (filter: relaxed). Top 8 kept.
Rating (documented, simple): rating = 70 + 15*min(1, apps/400) + 8*G + 6*min(1, caps/100), cap 99, where
G = min(1, goals/200) FWD, goals/80 MID, goals/25 DEF, apps/400 GK; caps = senior national caps (infobox). Unknown apps -> 0.
Not used: major honours (no uniform free source).
